item.tib: bsang mchod snang srid zhi bde
item.coloph: bsang mchod snang srid zhi bde kun 'byung 'di/ sde bzhi sgo 'phar byed pa'i rgya chen/ dge bcu pad tshal rgyas byed gong de yis/ bstan pa'i rgyu dang dgung du phyar ba'i tshe/ 'phrin las 'khor lo bsgyar ba'i mnga' bo che/ bstan pa bzang po yar rgyas ldan rigs par/ bsang mchod kun 'dus gyer bde zhig bskur ngor/ kun grol grags kyis steng chen dgon du bris//
